scopeNote: Compatibility requirements, not compatibility results. Every row is a requirement whose only permissible status is one of DOCUMENTED_INTERFACE, PROPOSED, ASSUMED, TEST_REQUIRED or BLOCKED. No row is TESTED or SUPPORTED; deviceTestRecorded is false everywhere. Rows are per family, protocol and data direction, never per brand and never per protocol name.

rows.candidateHardware: Candidate HUB appliance with an isolated NMEA 0183 listener interface (RS-422 differential, opto-isolated) and a documented sentence parser
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the third-party instrument transmits NMEA 0183 at 4800 baud 8N1 with the standard talker sentences and a reference ground that is not bonded to the vessel's DC negative in a way that defeats isolation. Not established by any test.
rows.knownLimitations: Only MWV/MWD parsing has executed unit-test evidence in the audited legacy stack; no electrical-layer implementation exists; USB-serial adapters were assumed historically; ground loops and galvanic isolation are unresolved; different vendors use proprietary sentences for the same quantity.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench test with an isolated talker simulator plus at least two real instruments; record device model, firmware version, sentence set, electrical levels, isolation resistance and error rate; publish only the exact tested combination.
certificationDependencies: No NMEA certification route for 0183; NMEA 0183 document licence NOT obtained
EMC test of the assembled appliance

rows.candidateHardware: Candidate HUB appliance with a documented GNSS intake path from a supported receiver
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a GNSS receiver publishes a documented sentence set with a valid fix-quality field and that time is derived from GNSS or an RTC. Receiver model and firmware are part of the matrix entry.
rows.knownLimitations: Legacy parser auto-detects /dev/ttyACM* or /dev/ttyUSB* without validating device identity; no fix-quality/freshness propagation into the HUB contract exists; GNSS time is not yet an authoritative time source in the design.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench: receiver in known sky-view conditions, fix loss induced, time and position freshness recorded; repeat with a second receiver family; document antenna and cable used.
certificationDependencies: No certification dependency for the HUB itself beyond EMC/EMC-RED when a radio is added

rows.candidateHardware: HUB with a galvanically isolated NMEA 2000 (ISO 11898 CAN, 250 kbit/s) interface
rows.interface: CAN 2.0B / ISO 11898-2 transceiver with isolation, NMEA 2000 Micro connector
rows.dataDirection: RECEIVE (a write direction is explicitly out of scope and prohibited)
requiredMessages: PGN-dependent; no PGN list can be frozen before a licensed standard copy exists
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: NONE PERMITTED. NMEA 2000 interoperability is not assumed, not estimated and not tested; the standard text is not held.
rows.knownLimitations: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no stack, no licence, no manufacturer code, no product certification, no hardware. NMEA requires certification of any product that reads or transmits NMEA 2000 information (EVD-MC11-001). A third-party gateway such as the Digital Yacht iKonvert could supply CAN-to-USB transport, but its own certification does not certify a MAREA product and a bidirectional gateway introduces a write path that must be physically or architecturally excluded.
rows.verificationMethod: Not verifiable in MC-11. Would require: NMEA 2000 licence, manufacturer code, implementation, certification tool run, NMEA validation, and only then device-level tests.
requiredTestEquipment: NMEA 2000 network with terminated backbone (not owned)
certificationDependencies: NMEA 2000 logo use only after certification

rows.candidateHardware: HUB local data service publishing and consuming Signal K paths
rows.protocol: Signal K over HTTP/WebSocket on the vessel LAN
rows.interface: Ethernet 10/100/1000 or Wi-Fi, TCP 3000-class WebSocket plus HTTP
rows.dataDirection: BIDIRECTIONAL (read-mostly; any write path must be enumerated and separately approved)
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a Signal K producer conforms to the published path model and that the consumer applies units and timestamp semantics consistently. Signal K is not a blanket compatibility guarantee.
rows.knownLimitations: Legacy publish/subscribe patterns exist but have no authentication and no product test; quality-flag propagation is absent; two Signal K servers may disagree on units and source priority; no certification scheme exists.
rows.verificationMethod: Integration test against a named Signal K server version with recorded paths, units, timestamps and failure behaviour; repeat after each server major version.
requiredTestEquipment: Reference Signal K server on a separate host
certificationDependencies: None from Signal K itself; Signal K specification is CC BY-SA 2.0 and server Apache-2.0 per the audited licence inventory

rows.candidateHardware: HUB client access from MAREA NAV, MAREA DISPLAY and a browser dashboard
rows.protocol: HTTPS/WSS local API (Signal K or MAREA-documented interface)
rows.interface: Vessel LAN, Ethernet or Wi-Fi; mDNS/DHCP or static addressing
rows.dataDirection: RECEIVE by clients; bounded write only for configuration by an authenticated owner
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes one local network with no untrusted tenants and no internet exposure; the legacy stack binds an unauthenticated API on 0.0.0.0 and is not acceptable for field use.
rows.knownLimitations: No authentication, no TLS, no device identity, no provisioning exist; no HUB dashboard build exists; network topology on a vessel is unknown.
rows.verificationMethod: Security review plus penetration test on a bench network before any field use; record authentication, session revocation and network exposure.
certificationDependencies: CRA secure-by-design obligations for a connectable product; no assessment started

rows.candidateHardware: MAREA NAV application consuming HUB-published vessel data on a customer phone/tablet/desktop
rows.protocol: HTTPS/WSS local API (Signal K or MAREA-documented interface)
rows.interface: Wi-Fi or Ethernet to the vessel network; device GNSS for own position when no HUB
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the customer device supplies GNSS and that the local interface is reachable without internet; chart and weather overlays require separate licensed entitlements.
rows.knownLimitations: No product integration test exists; browser/app sandboxing may block local discovery; device GNSS accuracy is outside MAREA control; NMEA 2000 absent.
rows.verificationMethod: End-to-end bench test with a HUB simulator and at least three device classes; record data age, stale-state behaviour and reconnection.
certificationDependencies: App-store distribution requirements; chart/weather licences separate

rows.candidateHardware: NAV consuming receive-only AIS targets from a compatible receiver
rows.protocol: NMEA 0183 !AIVDM over UDP/TCP or USB-serial; Signal K path where mapped
requiredMessages: !AIVDM sentence stream (both AIS channels if dual-channel)
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the AIS receiver emits standard !AIVDM sentences and that the consumer parses multi-part messages and channel information; no receiver is bundled with NAV.
rows.knownLimitations: No tested AIS path; CPA/TCPA requires own position, COG and SOG plus a validated computation boundary; AIS-derived retention and redistribution rights not granted.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench replay of recorded AIS traffic plus live reception; verify target age, stale/lost state and degradation when own position is missing.
requiredTestEquipment: Live AIS receiver with antenna (not owned)

rows.candidateHardware: NAV consuming licensed chart and forecast data
rows.protocol: HTTPS REST/tile services from licensed providers
requiredMessages: forecast fields with issue time and validity
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES a provider agreement exists for the intended use, geography and caching; none is granted (CHART_RIGHTS_GRANTED=false, WEATHER_PROVIDER_RIGHTS=NOT_GRANTED).
rows.knownLimitations: No chart or weather right exists; no offline-storage permission exists; provider terms may prohibit caching, redistribution or derived products.
rows.verificationMethod: Contract review first; then licence-conformance test of caching, offline storage, attribution and rate limits against the signed terms.
certificationDependencies: Attribution and terms displayed to the user

rows.candidateHardware: NAV connected to a third-party chartplotter or instrument system over NMEA 0183
rows.interface: USB-serial adapter or isolated serial interface provided by the customer
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a vendor-specific adapter and sentence set; NAV publishes no compatibility until the exact device/firmware/adapter is tested.
rows.knownLimitations: No tested adapter list; browser/OS serial access varies; vendor proprietary sentences are not standardised; NMEA 0183 standard text is not licensed.
rows.verificationMethod: Per-adapter test with a recorded device model, firmware and sentence set; publish only tested combinations.
certificationDependencies: NMEA 0183 document licence for standard text

rows.candidateHardware: Receive-only AIS receiver front end connected to a VHF antenna or splitter
rows.protocol: AIS VHF (161.975/162.025 MHz), receive direction only
rows.interface: 50-ohm coax, SO-239/PL-259 or N-type, dedicated antenna or splitter
requiredMessages: AIS messages 1,2,3,4,5,18,19,21,24 (class A/B position and static data)
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes adequate antenna height, coax loss and splitter isolation; reception quality follows installation and conditions and is never guaranteed.
rows.knownLimitations: No receiver hardware exists; no RF measurement, no EMC test, no RED conformity; dual-channel reception is a target and not asserted; no range claim is permissible.
rows.verificationMethod: RF bench: sensitivity, channel selectivity, spurious response and EMC pre-scan on the actual article; then an installed antenna test with a second reference receiver.
requiredTestEquipment: RF signal generator with AIS modulation (lab hire not authorised)

rows.candidateHardware: AIS receiver publishing targets as NMEA 0183 !AIVDM and a mapped Signal K path
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the consumer accepts standard !AIVDM and exposes target age; no consumer is certified or tested.
rows.knownLimitations: No decoder distribution decision (GPL-3.0 AIS-catcher cannot be shipped until DEC-04 is resolved); no output transport frozen; NMEA 2000 absent.
rows.verificationMethod: Output conformance test against a recorded AIVDM reference set; per-consumer integration test.

rows.candidateHardware: AIS receiver needing own-vessel position, COG and SOG for CPA/TCPA and distance/bearing
rows.protocol: NMEA 0183 / Signal K / HUB local interface
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a compatible GNSS source exists on board; the receiver alone supplies no own-vessel position.
rows.knownLimitations: No validated computation path for CPA/TCPA; without heading some derived values are not computable; receiver does not supply position.
rows.verificationMethod: Calculation validation against a reference implementation with recorded inputs; missing-input degradation test; never presented as collision avoidance.
certificationDependencies: None for the calculation; the consumed data rights remain separate

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE Wind adapter parsing NMEA 0183 MWV/MWD from a third-party wind instrument, or an original MAREA masthead sensor
rows.interface: RS-422 isolated serial at 4800 baud; mast cable
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the instrument transmits MWV/MWD with status 'A' and standard units (N/K/M); vendor-specific sentences are not accepted without a documented mapping.
rows.knownLimitations: Only parser-level unit tests exist; no real sensor test, no calibration record, no accuracy measurement; masthead cable loss and lightning exposure unresolved.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench with two instrument families plus mast-cable emulation; calibration against a reference anemometer (not available in MC-11).
certificationDependencies: EMC of the module and its cable

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE Power measuring battery/system voltage and charge/discharge current via a shunt or hall sensor
rows.protocol: Analogue measurement at the module (no external protocol)
rows.interface: Fused DC sense leads and shunt/hall sensor; isolated or high-side sensing to be defined
requiredMessages: derived state of charge only where a validated model exists
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the installer fits the shunt in the correct current path and that sense-lead polarity and fuse rating are documented; no accuracy figure is claimed.
rows.knownLimitations: No sensing element selected; accuracy NOT_MEASURED; common-mode voltage on a 24 V bank and alternator ripple unaddressed; no calibration procedure exercised.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench comparison against a calibrated reference meter across voltage/current range and temperature; then in-situ with a known load.
certificationDependencies: Electrical safety of the sense installation

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE Bilge reading a float switch contact
rows.interface: Isolated digital input with pull-up and wetting current suitable for a marine float switch
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a compatible float switch and that the modules is not the vessel's required bilge-alarm arrangement; the product is not a certified alarm.
rows.knownLimitations: No continuous level; switch contact bounce and corrosion unmeasured; not a substitute for the vessel's required bilge alarm.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench with simulated switch and real switch samples; corrosion and wetting-current assessment deferred to environmental test.

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE Tanks reading a compatible resistive or voltage-output tank sender
rows.interface: Documented sender excitation and input range; sender supplied by installer or third party
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the sender's resistance/voltage characteristic is known and documented; fuel and water are different fluids for calibration.
rows.knownLimitations: No sender compatibility list exists; calibration for irregular tank shapes is not solved; fuel-space installation is professional-only.
rows.verificationMethod: Per-sender calibration against measured volume; repeatability and drift test over temperature.
certificationDependencies: Installation in fuel space governed by the install assessment

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE module publishing measurements through a compatible MAREA HUB
rows.interface: Local vessel network (Wi-Fi/Ethernet) or a documented direct bus
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a HUB is present and publishes a documented contract; a SENSE module alone produces no user-facing data.
rows.knownLimitations: HUB contract not frozen; no test; wireless range and interference on a small vessel unmeasured.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench integration with a HUB simulator; then a real HUB when one exists; record latency and staleness thresholds.
certificationDependencies: RED if a radio is included

rows.candidateHardware: SENSE module with an NMEA 2000 interface
requiredMessages: not defined; no licensed standard copy held
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: NONE PERMITTED.
rows.knownLimitations: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. All six NMEA questions are unsatisfied (see nmea-status.json).
rows.verificationMethod: Not applicable in MC-11.

rows.candidateHardware: WATCH device consuming declared SENSE inputs (battery, bilge, temperature, position)
rows.protocol: Documented MAREA local sensor interface or direct measurement
rows.interface: Documented connectors/adapters per the installation; not the vessel's required alarm arrangement
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes the declared input set is complete and that the installation matches the documented low-risk configuration; a device with no connectivity still monitors locally.
rows.knownLimitations: No device exists; the monitored-input set is declared but not tested; freshness and last-known-good semantics are unbuilt.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench simulation of each input incl. open/short/fault; then a real installation with a commissioning record.
certificationDependencies: RED if a cellular radio is integrated

rows.candidateHardware: WATCH outbound-only cellular uplink via an internal modem and SIM/eSIM
rows.protocol: LTE Cat-M1/NB-IoT or LTE Cat-1/Cat-4 (to be selected); TCP/TLS or MQTT over cellular
rows.interface: Integrated modem with antenna connector; nano-SIM or eSIM
rows.dataDirection: TRANSMIT (outbound only; no inbound connection accepted)
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES a connectivity contract with a mobile network operator exists, including roaming and data-cap terms; none exists.
rows.knownLimitations: No modem selected, no antenna designed, no coverage assessment, no data plan, no provider contract; coverage in marinas and moorings of Galicia/northern Portugal is unmeasured; SMS fallback not designed.
rows.verificationMethod: Coverage survey at representative berths; modem RF test; network-loss and buffering/replay test across power cycles.

rows.candidateHardware: WATCH alert delivery through a push/notification provider to the owner's devices
rows.protocol: HTTPS provider API (APNs/FCM-class) plus email and optional SMS
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES provider accounts, terms and fees exist; none were created. Provider acceptance is not delivery and delivery is not human acknowledgement.
rows.knownLimitations: No provider contract; notification timestamps are specified but unbuilt; no guaranteed delivery is possible or permitted; provider outage handling is designed but untested.
rows.verificationMethod: Repeated end-to-end delivery tests under real network loss with measurement at each timestamp; record latency distribution, never a guarantee.
requiredTestEquipment: Test devices on two mobile networks
certificationDependencies: Provider terms; data-processing agreement; privacy impact assessment

rows.candidateHardware: WATCH reading data from MAREA HUB
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: NONE. WATCH does not require HUB and does not route HUB data ashore without a separately consented service.
rows.knownLimitations: Not an intended interface. Any future integration is a new product decision, not an assumption.
rows.verificationMethod: Not applicable.

rows.candidateHardware: DISPLAY dedicated hardware consuming HUB local data
rows.protocol: HTTPS/WSS local API over the vessel LAN
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: Assumes a HUB or compatible source exists and that the display's embedded runtime can host the approved application; no runtime exists.
rows.knownLimitations: No panel, compute module, enclosure or runtime exists; sunlight readability, wet/glove input and thermal behaviour are unmeasured; DISPLAY-EMBEDDED-RUNTIME=NOT_FOUND.
rows.verificationMethod: Bench with a HUB simulator; then photometric, thermal, ingress and wet/glove tests on the real article per the DISPLAY validation plan.
certificationDependencies: RED if a radio is included

rows.candidateHardware: DISPLAY showing weather entitlement data
rows.protocol: HTTPS provider API mediated by MAREA WEATHER
requiredMessages: forecast with provider, model run, valid time and freshness
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES the provider's display right permits rendering on a fixed device; NOT_GRANTED.
rows.knownLimitations: No provider agreement; display rights may be restricted; no caching permission.
rows.verificationMethod: Terms review, then licence-conformance test on the actual display.

rows.candidateHardware: PILOT control computer consuming a calibrated heading reference and steering/rudder feedback
rows.protocol: NMEA 0183 / proprietary serial / HUB read-only status
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES a compatible heading sensor and rudder feedback could be qualified; no steering input is qualified as a safety input.
rows.knownLimitations: PILOT_SAFETY_GATE=BLOCKED. No actuator path is designed or permitted in MC-11; heading and feedback integrity (calibration, deviation, plausibility) are unaddressed.
rows.verificationMethod: Cannot be verified before the safety case and physical bench/HIL/sea-trial programme exist and are authorised.
certificationDependencies: EMC for a switched motor drive

rows.candidateHardware: PILOT receiving route context from MAREA NAV
rows.dataDirection: RECEIVE (NAV supplies context; NAV never commands the helm)
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: NONE. Requires a future authorised integration after the safety case and independent validation.
rows.knownLimitations: No interface specified; safety case open; no control authority may be granted to NAV, HUB, DISPLAY or WATCH.
rows.verificationMethod: Not applicable in MC-11.

rows.candidateHardware: FLEET SaaS consuming authorised read-only WATCH telemetry
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES a WATCH subscription and an explicit organisation consent exist; neither exists.
rows.knownLimitations: Read-only boundary; no inbound vessel connection; no SLA; no telemetry integration built or tested.
rows.verificationMethod: Contract and consent design first; then API integration test with a WATCH simulator.

rows.candidateHardware: FLEET SaaS consuming HUB installation/telemetry health
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES the organisation authorises it and a HUB exists; no contract exists.
rows.knownLimitations: No HUB data-export service exists; consent and scope undefined; no SLA.
rows.verificationMethod: Design and contract first; then integration test.

rows.candidateHardware: MAREA WEATHER service consuming licensed provider forecast/observation APIs
requiredMessages: atmospheric fields with model run and valid time
rows.thirdPartyAssumption: ASSUMES provider agreements for commercial display, caching and derived products exist; WEATHER_PROVIDER_RIGHTS=NOT_GRANTED.
rows.knownLimitations: No provider contract; no evaluation of forecast quality in the pilot geography; no source registry built; accuracy is unclaimable.
rows.verificationMethod: Terms review, then a declared evaluation against observations with published methodology; never an accuracy claim without it.
